description: CANN FusedInferAttentionScore routes its intermediate tiles through per-AIC-core GM rings. A ring slot's distinct GM extent is the widest store that lands in it, so a core that runs many tasks reuses the same slots rather than touching new addresses. The write-back residency probe found L0C->GM (Fixpipe) and UB->GM (MTE3) obey one rule, write_hit = 1 - slots/passes, so both engines are charged the same way. This file records only launch geometry read from the kernel sources: buffer names, owning engine, rotation key, slot extent and element width. It carries no duration and no measured traffic.

fixed_decode.slot_addressing: aiCoreIdx * dbWorkspaceRatio * slotElements, indexed by rotation_key % PRELOAD_NUM

flash_decode_buffers.note: bound only inside the ASCEND_IS_AIV branch of InitWorkspace; the ASCEND_IS_AIC branch that follows receives matmulService alone and never sees them, and every reference in fia_block_vec_flashdecode.h copies GM into UB, which is a read. They are not Fixpipe destinations.

rotation_counters.info.loop: advances once per (task, s2 chunk) pair; CalcParams(loop, bN2Cur, gS1Cur, s2Cur, ...) at fia_kernel_nonquant_mla.h:498-503
rotation_counters.bn2IdxInCurCore: advances only when isFirstSInnerLoop, i.e. once per (bN2, gS1) head-task; fia_kernel_nonquant_mla.h:557-561

kv_operand_aliasing.note: one latent per position; the value operand is that latent's leading value_head_dim channels, so both operands are real at L2 but share a single compulsory GM footprint. Charging qk_head_dim + value_head_dim counts the same bytes twice, (576+512)/576 = 1.889.

split_fuse_prefill.rotation_counter: stackSeqCount, declared inside the per-query-block body at flash_attention_regular.h:297 so every task restarts the ring at slot 0
split_fuse_prefill.slot_capacity_note: WORKSPACE_BLOCK_SIZE_DB = Q_TILE_CEIL * MAX_KV_STACK_LEN is the reserved capacity, not the written width; each store reaches rowNum times its own layout stride

strides.stackSeqTilePad: blockStackNum * pagedBlockSize with blockStackNum = MAX_KV_STACK_LEN / pagedBlockSize, so it equals the stack ceiling however the pages divide it (flash_attention_regular.h:293-295)

inadmissible_columns.L1_to_GM_datas(KB)(estimate): The FIA cube block has only GM->L1 copies (common/CopyInL1.h:61, fia_block_cube_nonquant_gqa.h:783) and no L1->GM write path, and the column carries an (estimate) suffix because msprof infers it. It must be excluded from the measured side of any diagnostic, not only from the model.

framework_per_core_gm_clear.scope: every AscendC MIX kernel entry, emitted by the framework rather than by the operator
framework_per_core_gm_clear.derivation: BIDIRECTION_NUM(2) * MAX_MSG_COUNT(64) * AlignTo32(sizeof(KfcMsg)=128) * MIX_NUM(2) = 32768, plus MIX_NUM(2) * AlignTo32(sizeof(MsgUBAvalied)=64) = 128
framework_per_core_gm_clear.addressing: workspace + (size + msgOffset11) * GetBlockIdxImpl(), so each core clears its own KFC message region; block = size / 2048 = 16 copies of 2048 B
framework_per_core_gm_clear.why_it_is_invisible_in_L0C_to_GM: it is an L1->GM copy (copy_cbuf_to_gm), not a Fixpipe L0C->GM store, so it never appears in L0C_to_GM_datas. This is why the authoritative write counter exceeds L0C_to_GM by about this amount and why the FIA operator sources contain no writer for it.
framework_per_core_gm_clear.agreement: measured authoritative AIC DRAM write minus the predicted source ring, per AIC core, divided by 32896: 1.024 / 1.024 / 1.020 on the three decode layouts and 1.057 to 1.068 on the four prefill layouts, median 1.033 over 278 non-MLA cases
framework_per_core_gm_clear.not_yet_priced: recorded but not charged in Forward; see docs/decisions.md §1 for why the attachment point needs its own memory path
